description: This PHP source file defines the MailMessage class, which extends Symfony's Email class to provide specialized email message handling within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to set email subject, sender, recipients, and body with support for plain text and HTML content types.

classes.name: MailMessage
classes.description: A specialized email message class extending Symfony's Email, tailored for the OrangeHRM system with methods for setting email parameters and content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a MailMessage instance with a specified content type, defaulting to HTML.

methods.name: setFrom
methods.description: Sets the sender addresses with optional names.

methods.name: setMailBody
methods.description: Sets the email body, choosing between plain text and HTML based on the content type.
